problem_statement: The message cloning API should be able to produce a copy of a message while choosing the reserved-header size of the resulting message (and an arbitrary number of payload bytes to copy), rather than being forced to reproduce the original message's reserved-header size. In particular, cloning to a smaller length, and cloning with a different (e.g. zero or larger) reserved header size, should yield a valid message whose reserved-header size, length, offset, type, subtype, link-security state, priority and other metadata are copied appropriately. Currently there is no way to clone a message with a different reserved header size than the original.
